WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Estimation of Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Estimation of Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Estimation of Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Estimation of Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.

2. When learning Furniture Making, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Furniture Making.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Furniture Making.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Furniture Making.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.

3. When learning Blending wood with other materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending wood with other materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Blending wood with other materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending wood with other materials.

4. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.

5. When learning Design in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Design in Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Design in Woodwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Design in Woodwork.

6. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

8. When learning Framed Wooden Doors and Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

11. When learning Entrepreneurship in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

12. When learning Project Activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Activity.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project Activity.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Activity.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Project Activity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Design in Woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Estimation of Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Occupational Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.

7. A — CPU
